title: Written Order, Formulary Exception and Coverage Verification Periods by Insulin Pharmacy Tier
content:
For the Insulin and Injection Supply Pharmacy Program, the authorization desk works from seven period figures per tier.

- **Order validity** — validity of the prescriber's written order, in calendar months counted from the order date.
- **Prior authorization required** — whether the payer requires prior authorization before this product line ships.
- **Formulary exception validity** — validity of an approved formulary exception (recorded as a payer prior authorization grant for a non-preferred insulin), in calendar months counted from the payer decision date unless the approval states an earlier valid-through date; 0 means no formulary exceptions on the tier.
- **Renewal lead** — the earliest point for submitting a prior authorization renewal, in calendar days before the valid-through date of the authorization being renewed; 0 means no prior authorization on the tier.
- **Standard decision time** — the payer's decision time for a standard formulary exception or prior authorization request, in calendar days counted from the request date (Part D and MA-PD coverage determinations - 3 days; Medicaid drug requests - 1 day); 0 means none.
- **Expedited decision time** — the payer's decision time for an expedited prior authorization request, in hours counted from submission; 0 means no prior authorization.
- **Coverage reverification** — how recently the coverage record must have been verified with the payer before a refill ships, in calendar months counted back from the ship date; 0 means no coverage to verify.

| Tier | Order validity (months) | Prior authorization required | Exception validity (months) | Renewal lead (days) | Standard decision (days) | Expedited decision (hours) | Coverage reverification (months) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Insulin Pharmacy Self-Pay Program | 12 | No | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Insulin Pharmacy Commercial HMO Program | 12 | No | 12 | 30 | 15 | 72 | 6 |
| Insulin Pharmacy Commercial PPO Program | 12 | No | 12 | 30 | 15 | 72 | 12 |
| Insulin Pharmacy Medicare Advantage Prescription Drug Program | 12 | No | 12 | 30 | 3 | 24 | 12 |
| Insulin Pharmacy Medicare Part D Program | 12 | No | 12 | 30 | 3 | 24 | 12 |
| Insulin Pharmacy Medicare Part B Pump Insulin Program | 12 | No | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 12 |
| Insulin Pharmacy Medicaid Program | 12 | No | 12 | 21 | 1 | 24 | 1 |

## Observations

- No tier of the Insulin and Injection Supply Pharmacy Program requires prior authorization before the product line ships.
- The Insulin Pharmacy Self-Pay Program and the Insulin Pharmacy Medicare Part B Pump Insulin Program show 0 for exception validity, renewal lead and both decision times: neither tier has formulary exceptions.
- The Insulin Pharmacy Self-Pay Program shows 0 months for coverage reverification because it has no coverage to verify. The Insulin Pharmacy Medicaid Program requires the most recent verification (within 1 month of the ship date) and the Insulin Pharmacy Commercial HMO Program within 6 months.
